title: Method and System for Neural Network Image Processing in Automated Medical Screening
abstract: A machine learning pipeline configured to receive multi-sequence MRI datasets, apply attention-based 3D convolutional operations, and output probability distributions for tissue abnormalities.
technology_domain: Medical Imaging, Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence

title: Quantum Random Number Generator Integrated with Optical Transceivers for Network Security
abstract: An integrated photonic device comprising a single-photon source and balanced homodyne detection circuit for high-throughput quantum entropy generation.

title: Composite Polymer-Ceramic Electrolyte for All-Solid-State Sodium Batteries
abstract: A flexible solid electrolyte layer with high ionic conductivity at room temperature, comprising a polyether matrix impregnated with sodium super-ionic conductor particles.

title: Engineered Cas13 Nucleases for High-Specificity RNA Targeting in Eukaryotic Cells
abstract: Modified RNA-guided endoribonucleases featuring engineered HEPN domains exhibiting reduced off-target RNA cleavage while preserving target transcript degradation efficacy.
